documents.note: A structurally valid PDF with zero pages. Included on purpose: a 0-page document is the edge case where every rate has an empty denominator, and the harness must score it without dividing by zero.
One page carrying a Helvetica text layer.
One page that is a single full-bleed image and has no text operators at all.
Ten dense single-column text pages plus one two-column page; the two-column page probes layout detection but still has a text layer, so no page needs OCR.

24 pages repeating text, text, image. 16 of 24 pages carry text, which clears pdf-inspector's own text_page_ratio_threshold; doc-router derives the label from the page list instead, so the 8 image pages stay visible.
The same 24 pages rotated so each group leads with the image page.
30 image-only pages: every page needs OCR.

Six scans that already went through a cheap OCR pass: each page carries a hidden text layer (alternating invisible 3 Tr overlay and normal-render layer under the scan) whose transcription has confused characters, dropped lines and fused words. pdf-inspector counts the text operators and calls the document text_based, so the heuristic flags nothing; every page needs OCR precisely because the text it already has is wrong.

Five memo pages whose complete, correct text layer sits under a full-page RECEIVED stamp. The stamp makes the document image_based and the eight-line body falls under pdf-inspector's ten-operator floor, so every page is flagged; no page needs OCR, because every word is already in the text layer.

Five text pages whose Helvetica font carries a syntactically valid /ToUnicode CMap that maps every letter to its Cyrillic neighbour. Rendering never consults /ToUnicode so the pages are correct on screen; extraction consults nothing else, so the text layer is mojibake and every page needs OCR while the heuristic flags none.

Five scanned correspondence pages whose only text layer is furniture -- running head, folio, file reference, box number. Twelve short operators clear pdf-inspector's ten-operator floor, so nothing is flagged; not one word of the pages' content is in the text layer, so every page needs OCR.

The control: three ordinary text pages alternating with three honest scans that carry no text operators at all. Structure and truth agree on every page, so the heuristic scores this document perfectly -- the adversarial source is not rigged.

Two stamped invoices (complete text layer under a full-page RECEIVED stamp) alternating with two ordinary text pages. The stamped pages are flagged and need no OCR; the document is wasted OCR only, with clean pages beside it so per-page routing is exercised.

Two broken-/ToUnicode pages and one honest scan among two ordinary text pages. The scan is flagged and correctly so; the two mojibake pages are not, and need OCR -- the heuristic is right and wrong inside one document.

Eight archive pages, every one of them a scan: three pre-OCR'd with a bad hidden layer, two carrying only records-office furniture, one more bad layer, and two honest scans. Only the two honest scans are flagged; all eight need OCR.

Twelve case-file pages mixing all four traps with four clean text pages and two honest scans: bad OCR layer, stamped text, chrome over a scan and broken /ToUnicode. Both error directions appear in one document -- four pages needing OCR go unflagged and two stamped pages are flagged that do not.
